job.title: Data & AI Strategy Manager @ Datashift (Mechelen, VLG, BE)
job.description:
Demand for data & AI projects is growing fast. To keep up, we are looking for a Strategy Manager – Data & AI to lead engagements, accounts and teams. You take Data & AI engagements from strategy through implementation and make sure clients get real, measurable value out of data and AI. First, you manage a team of strategy consultants to shape the strategy with the client; selecting the right use cases, defining the roadmap, aligning stakeholders and validating the business impact. Then you lead the implementation track that turns that strategy into reality, steering a mix of strategy, implementation and expert profiles. You also ‘debug’ Data & AI organizations, for example by reshaping their operating model or ways of working.

In this role, you’re the go-to partner for C-level and senior management, and you work hand in hand with technical experts from Datashift and the client. You own key client relationships and accounts, lead your own teams and help grow our Data & AI Strategy practice.

A few examples of recent engagements (anonymized):

* A large multinational struggled to get value from a fragmented landscape of AI initiatives. We led the team that defined a short- and long-term AI roadmap, which brought focus and delivered early value.
* The Belgian branch of a large multinational wanted to use AI to return to profitability but struggled to find the right use cases. We helped select them, then guided the build of a voicebot and scaled it to production.
* After a merger of several data and IT teams, a client asked us to identify pain points and opportunities for improvement. Together with our technical experts, we defined a target architecture and redesigned the roles and ways of working across the organization.

**Why Datashift**

Datashift is not a classic strategy firm. Our Strategy team is part of a full-service Data & AI delivery company, so the roadmaps you design actually get built, often by the colleagues sitting next to you.

* See your strategy implemented. You don’t hand over a deck and walk away: you follow your recommendations through to production and measurable results, working alongside our data engineers, AI specialists and analytics experts.
* Own accounts and results. In a small team, you own client relationships, accounts and their P&L.
* Shape a young practice. As a manager, you will be actively involved and have a real say in our offering, our methods and how the team grows.
* Build deep Data & AI expertise in one of the most in-demand fields in business. The AI field is evolving at a rapid pace, creating new services, new expertise and new opportunities. You are encouraged to take initiative, and good ideas are picked up fast.

**Your responsibilities**

As a Strategy Manager – Data & AI, you will:

* Lead a portfolio of Data & AI engagements and own the client relationships behind them, from framing the business challenge to driving implementation.
* Act as a trusted advisor to C-level and senior stakeholders, challenging their thinking and shaping their Data & AI agenda.
* Design the operating models, governance and ways of working that allow Data & AI organizations to deliver real value.
* Bridge strategy and delivery: work hand in hand with Datashift’s technical teams and steer execution on business outcomes.
* Grow the practice: win new business, shape our offering and thought leadership, and build and coach a high-performing team.

**Job requirements**
--------------------

**Your qualifications**

* Master’s degree in Business Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Analytics or a related field.
* 6–10 years of relevant experience, preferably in strategy consulting with exposure to Data, Analytics or AI projects.
* A deep understanding of how Data & AI impact organizations, their operating models and ways of working.
* A proven track record of leading complex client engagements and the multidisciplinary teams behind them.
* Experience translating strategic recommendations into concrete roadmaps and steering their implementation.
* Credibility with C-level and senior management, while remaining close to day-to-day project delivery.
* Commercial and business-development responsibility: you have grown client accounts, led proposals and won new business.
* Excellent communication, leadership and interpersonal skills.
* In-depth technical knowledge or coding experience is welcome, but not required.
* Fluent in English and Dutch or French.

**Our offer**

* A fast-growing, entrepreneurial Strategy team within Datashift, with plenty of room to grow and make your mark.
* A transparent career path based on impact rather than tenure, backed by continuous training and mentoring.
* Visible impact on our clients and on Datashift’s growth, recognized in your bonus and progression.
* Driven, motivated colleagues and a no-nonsense culture focused on quality and impact.
* Excellent terms of employment, including company car, fuel card, meal vouchers and bonus.
* Work from our offices in Mechelen, Leuven or Ghent.

job.title: Project Manager @ Isabel Group (Brussels, BRU, BE)
job.description:
**Let’s shape the future of finance - together**

At Isabel, we believe that real innovation happens when people and ideas connect

That’s why we’re building more than technology, we’re building an ecosystem.

One where every voice counts, and where your work can truly make a difference.

We’re looking for curious minds and collaborative builders. People who believe success means growing together, learning from each other, and challenging the status quo.

If that sounds like you, keep reading.

**What you’ll do**

You’ll need to thrive in mastering complex projects with high visibility; you’ll be steering the KUBE project consisting of different tracks or sub-projects, including, but not limited to the core common product components, the integration tracks with banks, the contractual, legal, migration and transition tracks.

This means creating a way forward with multiple high-level stakeholders with overarching responsibilities in a complex technological environment.

You will be responsible for managing the time, scope, and budget but most of all the business outcome of the projects and will have to proactively drive the different stakeholders to achieve expected results.

  

* Define project objectives, scope, and deliverables in collaboration with stakeholders.
* Translate business needs into actionable project plans aligned with strategic goals.

* Manage demand, governance, and supply to keep all stakeholders aligned on their responsibilities in delivering the project.
* Lead project execution and coordinate delivery activities across all involved teams.
* Assess and manage the risks and incidents related to the delivery of your project and sub- projects and solve issues quickly and efficiently to limit the impact and/or risks.
* Prevent scope creep by enforcing a clear ‘change management process’.
* Be on top of each track to be able to properly report on progress, KPI’s, decision taking and drive Steerco for appropriate information & decision processes.
* Actively contribute to the realization of the project, propose adequate solutions to unlock bottlenecks, supervise, and validate every aspect of the projects to have them meet the organizational requirements, in line with the methodology and the quality standards agreed amongst stakeholders.
* Facilitate communication and collaboration to maintain a good relationship with all internal and external stakeholders concerned.
* Report to stakeholders such as Steerco, Executive Sponsors, Isabel Mgt & Board.

**What makes you a great fit**

You’ll have to combine strong Project Management skills, product knowledge and strong stakeholder management to be able to meet business objectives and customer expectations.

You’ll thrive in this role if you:

  

* Master’s degree in a relevant field (e.g., Computer Science, Business Administration).
* At least 10 years of experience as a customer facing program or project manager for large and complex ICT projects, preferably in financial or telco sector.
* A certification as project manager of an industry recognized organization (Prince2, PMI, …).
* Good command of English & Dutch or French (both written and spoken).

* Proven experience in driving complex projects/programs and rescuing difficult projects.
* Previous experience within highly regulated industries (banks, telco’s, insurance, …) and/or closely scrutinized projects (EU-commission, NATO, …).
* At ease in driving teams under indirect supervision.
* Decisive

* Negotiating skills: experience in both internal and client-facing environments.
* Excellent communication tailored to diverse audiences (technical, executive, client).
* Strong stakeholder engagement and expectation management.
* Comfortable navigating ambiguity, shifting priorities, and organizational change.

**Why join us**

At Isabel, we offer more than a job, we offer a place to grow, contribute, and thrive.

* A human-sized Belgian company (250 people) where your ideas and impact matter
* 50% hybrid work, flexible hours, and autonomy to manage your time
* Coaching, training, and tailored development paths for every career stage
* A flat, collaborative structure with real ownership and cross-functional work
* Competitive rewards: Flex Income Plan, annual bonus, insurance, meal vouchers
* A strong engagement culture and inclusive mindset

* Easy mobility options: our MOBI strategy supports flexible, low-footprint commuting, whether by bike, public transport, or electric car
* Professional gatherings that encourage collaboration and networking, as well as fun and purposeful activities led by our BeFun team
* A certified Top Employer with 30 years of tech leadership and ambition

**Ready to join us?**

Your voice, your vision, and your impact all have a place here.

Let’s shape smarter solutions and a stronger digital economy. Together.

job.title: Technical Project Manager remote from EU - Deadline 12/11/26 @ AlmavivA do Brasil (BRU, BE)
job.description:
Project Management Plan — project scope, objectives, approach, organisation, governance and delivery methodology.

Project roadmap and schedule — activities, milestones, dependencies, deadlines and delivery planning.

Work Breakdown Structure (WBS) — structured breakdown of project deliverables and activities.

Project status / progress reports — regular reporting on progress, achievements, milestones, delays and upcoming activities.

Project dashboards and KPI reports — consolidated indicators covering schedule, scope, resources, budget, risks and overall project health.

Risk and issue registers — identified risks/issues, impact, probability, mitigation measures, owners and follow-up

TASK:

* Manage the implementation of projects to meet identified business needs, acquiring and using the necessary resources and Skills, within agreed parameters of cost, timescales, and quality.
* Work closely with the project’s Business Manager (BM) on business justification, project definition, and Business Implementation.
* Develop comprehensive project plans covering scope, schedule, budget, resources, quality, and risk management.
* Guide the team in charge of project activities and review their deliverables.
* Participate in functional working groups and progress meetings.
* Estimate costs, timescales and resource requirements for the successful completion of each project to agreed terms of reference.
* Prepare and maintain project and quality plans and tracks activities against the plan, provide regular and accurate reports.
* Monitor costs, timescales and resources used. Take action where these deviate from agreed tolerances. Ensure that delivered systems are implemented within these criteria.
* Manage the change control procedure gaining agreement for revisions to the project from project sponsors.
* Provide effective leadership for the project team ensuring that team members are motivated and constantly developing their Skills and experience.
* Manage all project stakeholders through a structured communication plan, stakeholder mapping, and regular status reporting aligned to governance cadence.
* Assess technical impact of implementations, features and requests.
* Assess technical viability of features and requests in accordance to the reality of the product.
* Give presentations of the product, features and/or new implementation to prospective or existing clients and stakeholders.

SPECIFIC EXPERTISE:

* Experience in managing projects.
* Knowledge of recognised project management methodologies, such as PRINCE2, PMBOK, and Agile frameworks.
* Expertise in planning and financial practices such as project scheduling, strategic planning, budgeting, forecasting, financial modelling, and performance tracking.
* Excellent knowledge of Agile methodology, Scrum Management, Lean agile.
* Experience with project management software such as JIRA and Microsoft Project.
* Experience with collaboration platforms such as Confluence and SharePoint.
* Experience in facilitation of meetings.
* Practical knowledge of reporting methods.
* Knowledge of software development (backend/frontend languages and technologies,

e.g. Java, JavaScript, Angular, etc.) is a plus.

* Familiar with architectural patterns,
* Familiar with CSDR, AXON server, KAFKA, Cloud technologies.

Deadline 12/11/26

Delivery mode: Remote from Europe

Only EU Citizens can apply

job.title: Consultant Expérimenté Strategy - Aero & Defense (F/H) @ Deloitte (La Défense, Île-de-France, France)
job.description:
**Quel sera votre rôle dans la #TeamDeloitte ?**
Comptant près de 1000 collaborateurs en France, notre activité Strategy, Risk & Transactions (SRT) réunit une combinaison d’expertises unique sur le marché. Nous accompagnons nos clients dans leurs transformations, du conseil en stratégie à la mise en œuvre opérationnelle, sur leurs enjeux transactionnels (M&A), de management des risques, de modélisation économique et financière, et de développement durable.
  
  
Vous intégrerez les équipes de Monitor Deloitte, cabinet de stratégie de premier plan qui œuvre auprès des directions générales de nos clients. Avec près de 2 000 consultants en Europe et un réseau mondial de plus de 7 000 consultants, nos équipes Monitor Deloitte accompagnent les grandes entreprises et fonds d’investissements dans les projets de transformation et de recherche de performance les plus complexes.
  
  
En tant que Consultant expérimenté, vous serez pleinement impliqué-e sur des missions à forte valeur ajoutée en vue d'accompagner nos clients – principalement des grandes organisation, public ou privé, opérant au sein du secteur de la Défense et de l’Espace – sur leurs grands projets de transformation. Vos missions sont :
  
  

* Réaliser des analyses de marché et anticiper les évolutions technologiques et réglementaires du secteur aérospatial et défense
* Réaliser des benchmarks concurrentiels et des études comparatives sectorielles
* Accompagner les clients dans la définition et l’exécution de leur stratégie de croissance (diversification, internationalisation, partenariats)
* Mener des missions de due diligence stratégique lors d’opérations de fusions-acquisitions ou de cessions d’actifs
* Élaborer des plans d’optimisation opérationnelle (supply chain, amélioration de la performance industrielle, lean manufacturing)
* Accompagner la conduite du changement auprès des équipes internes et des partenaires industriels
* Préparer et animer des ateliers stratégiques avec les directions générales pour définir les feuilles de route à moyen et long terme
* Suivre les politiques publiques, les appels d’offres et les financements spécifiques au secteur

Vous grandissez au sein d’une équipe où se mêlent pluridisciplinarité, expertise pointue, esprit d'entreprendre et fort engagement.
  
  
Vous développez un set de compétences structurées autour de trois grandes dimensions suivantes : leadership, métier (stratégie) et spécialité (Aerospace & Defence). Vous participez aux programmes de formations internationaux proposé pour renforcer progressivement ces compétences et en acquérir de nouvelles. Tout au long de votre expérience, vous grandissez grâce à un management de proximité, de responsabilisation et d’accompagnement personnalisé.
  
  
**Et si c’était vous ?**

* Vous êtes titulaire d’un Bac+5 d'une grande école (ingénieurs ou commerce) et bénéficiez idéalement d’une expérience d’au moins 2 année en conseil en stratégie et/ou dans le secteur de la Défense ou de l’Espace ;
* Vous souhaitez contribuer à la structuration et au développement d’une activité dans un nouveau cabinet et vous avez donc un esprit entrepreneurial ;
* Vous faites preuve de qualités d'adaptation, de rigueur, d'esprit d’analyse et de synthèse qui vous permettent de contribuer à l'excellence de notre service auprès des clients ;
* Vous aimez travailler en équipe, vous disposez de qualités de communication orale et écrite reconnues ;
* Vous êtes curieux(se), autonome et proactif(ve), atouts indispensables pour réussir les missions confiées ;
* Vous maitrisez parfaitement l’anglais à l’oral et à l’écrit.

***#ALLIN***
?:
*tous les candidats ont leur place chez Deloitte sans aucune distinction, nous croyons en un environnement inclusif.*

job.title: Strategic Enterprise Sales Manager Europe (English) @ 4PS France (Paris, A8, FR)
Project Scientist – II (Urban Heat Expert) @ United Nations (Paris, A8, FR)
job.description:
Result of Service

The result of services is to support UNEP cities in achieving extreme heat resilience. Service is required in carrying out Urban Heat Assessments in 50 cities in India, following UNEP-CEPT UHIE Assessment methodology. This will include urban heat island effect assessments and approaches to adapt cities to rising temperatures, including providing medium- and long-term adaptation and mitigation strategies such as increasing nature-based solutions, cool surfaces, shaded and pervious surfaces and other passive cooling approaches into the city heat governance and local action plans.

Work Location

India, remote

Expected duration

12 months

Duties and Responsibilities

The United Nations Environment Programme (UNEP) is the leading global environmental authority that sets the global environmental agenda, promotes the coherent implementation of the environmental dimension of sustainable development within the United Nations system, and serves as an authoritative advocate for the global environment. UNEP's Climate Change Division has as objective to deliver effective strategic guidance and high-impact action in support of the transition towards climate stability. Its work is guided by ambition, innovation, credible science, and alignment to global climate goals and needs of individual countries. The Climate Change Division works with Member States and partners to accelerate and support a just transition by addressing climate change mitigation and adaptation through enhancing implementation capacity, provision of data, information and knowledge, access to finance and technology, and building resilience. It promotes sustainable development and effective policies for climate stability; supports action so that countries progress on decarbonization, dematerialization and resilience pathways in line with their climate commitments, aspirations and needs; and fosters transparency in reporting. The Cool Coalition is a UNEP-led global multi-stakeholder platform that supports governments, cities, businesses and international partners to deliver sustainable cooling solutions that advance climate mitigation, climate resilience, air quality, energy access and sustainable development goals. The Cool Coalition is part of the Climate Change Division under the Cooling and Buildings Unit, Sectoral Transformation Section. The consultant’s assignment is to provide technical expertise to national and subnational implementation activities on sustainable urban cooling in India (urban design, passive cooling, district cooling) including direct technical support to subnational governments and real estate developers; development of knowledge products, tools, training material and communication pieces. Consultant will be part of the Buildings and Cooling Unit of the Mitigation Branch, Climate Change Division, United Nations Environment Programme (UNEP). Specifically, they are needed to support the delivery of UNEP’s India Cooling Programme which is being implemented by UNEP under the framework of the Cool Coalition.

Qualifications/special skills

The consultant should have PhD or Post Doctoral with post graduate qualification in environment planning, urban planning, Climate Science, Urban meteorology, energy engineering or related field. A minimum of 2 years’ experience in a relevant field of work, preferably with a focus on extreme heat, cooling, urban & environment planning, and climate science. Practical experience in India is essential in scientific assessments, climate analysis, urban heat island analysis and city engagement. Experience in working with diverse research, academic and international organizations is essential. Qualifying years of experience are calculated following the receipt of the first level university degree recognized by the United Nations.

Languages

English and French are the working languages of the United Nations Secretariat. For this post, fluency in written and oral English is required. Knowledge of Hindi is required. Knowledge of another UN language would be an advantage.

Additional Information

Not available.

No Fee

THE UNITED NATIONS DOES NOT CHARGE A FEE AT ANY STAGE OF THE RECRUITMENT PROCESS (APPLICATION, INTERVIEW MEETING, PROCESSING, OR TRAINING). THE UNITED NATIONS DOES NOT CONCERN ITSELF WITH INFORMATION ON APPLICANTS’ BANK ACCOUNTS.

job.title: Chef.fe de projet innovation et offres portuaires H/F @ MGI (Marseille Gyptis International) (Marseille, Provence-Alpes-Côte d'Azur, France)
job.description:
MGI conçoit et exploite depuis près de 40 ans les systèmes communautaires qui numérisent le passage portuaire de la marchandise, à Marseille-Fos et dans une quinzaine de ports français et d’Outre-mer. Ses solutions relient au quotidien terminaux, transitaires, transporteurs, logisticiens, autorités portuaires et douane.

La Direction de la Transformation porte la création de nouveaux services numériques pour la communauté portuaire, en France et à l’international : gestion des accès et des habilitations, coordination des flux terrestres, systèmes d’information portuaires. Elle conduit aussi l’évolution des pratiques internes de MGI.

**Votre mission :**

**Les enjeux du poste :**
faire adopter de nouveaux services par la communauté portuaire, du terrain jusqu'à l'usage réel. Le poste combine, à parts égales, compréhension des utilisateurs et conduite de projet.

**Mission :**

* **Comprendre les utilisateurs et leurs processus :**
  Vous allez voir les terminaux, transitaires et logisticiens, et vous animez des ateliers de découverte (en français comme en anglais) pour repérer le vrai problème.
* **Cadrer :**
  vous évaluez la valeur et la viabilité d'un service avant de le construire. Vous rédigez le PRD et définissez objectifs, jalons, budget et risques.
* **Conduire :**
  vous pilotez avec les équipes produit et techniques, animez les COPIL et corrigez les écarts.
* **Faire adopter :**
  vous embarquez les premiers utilisateurs, conduisez le changement et mesurez l'adoption après la mise en service.
* **Rayonner :**
  vous contribuez aux appels d'offres et aux démarches auprès de ports étrangers, et vous diffusez à MGI l'écoute client et la décision fondée sur les données d'usage.

**Votre profil :**

* Au moins
  **5 ans d'expérience**
  , dont une part significative dans le
  **portuaire, le maritime ou la logistique**
  (terminal, commission de transport, autorité portuaire, douane, système communautaire…)
* Vous avez déjà
  **tenu un planning et un budget**
  sur un projet ou une activité
* Votre
  **anglais est courant**
  , assez solide pour animer un atelier international

**Un plus :**

* vous avez déjà fait adopter un outil par une communauté, lancé un service, été utilisateur clé d'un déploiement logiciel,
* vous connaissez les méthodes agiles.

**Votre manière de travailler :**

* vous écoutez avant de proposer,
* vous embarquez sans autorité hiérarchique,
* vous synthétisez bien
* vous êtes rigoureux dans le suivi.

**Ce que nous vous offrons :**

* **Un rôle transverse**
  au cœur de la stratégie de MGI, avec une forte exposition auprès de la direction et de la place portuaire
* **Des services neufs à construire**
  , en France et à l'international, dans une équipe resserrée
* **Une évolution vers un rôle de responsable d'offre**
  à mesure que les services se développent

job.title: Marketing Manager Energy @ HASKONING (Amersfoort, UT, NL)
job.description:
4758 - 5997CorporateMarketing and CommunicationsExperienced

* Amersfoort |
* Delft

The energy transition depends on energy projects being delivered. Limited grid capacity, complex consenting processes and investment risks make this challenging for our clients. As Marketing Manager Energy, you translate these client challenges into Haskoning’s global marketing and communications strategy for Energy. Through relevant value propositions and targeted campaigns, you connect our expertise with the clients who need it. In doing so, you use your marketing skills to contribute to our commercial growth and the energy transition.

*- The deadline to apply is 11 November -*

**What you will do as Marketing Manager Energy**
------------------------------------------------

You develop the global marketing and communications strategy for Energy and take responsibility for its implementation. You combine strategic decisions with an active role in delivery, working with the content and digital marketers to turn the strategy into practical marketing plans and campaigns for Europe, Southeast Asia and Australia.

You work closely with the Business Unit Director and Commercial Director to agree priorities, using client and market insights to guide your choices. With the commercial teams, you work towards shared plans and objectives, connecting marketing activities to new business, revenue growth and profitability.

Your responsibilities include:

* **Market insight and propositions:** researching client needs and competitors, and using your findings to sharpen our positioning and value propositions.
* **Marketing plans and campaigns:** turning business priorities into actionable plans, developing campaign briefs and working with colleagues to deliver targeted global campaigns tailored to regional needs.
* **Content and events:** working with technical experts and marketers to develop relevant content and organise webinars, industry events and other activities that help clients understand our expertise.
* **Commercial collaboration:** contributing to account and growth plans, developing marketing materials for client conversations and tenders, and agreeing how campaign leads will be followed up.
* **Budgets and performance:** managing the marketing budget and external partners, monitoring progress and results, and adjusting activities to improve their commercial contribution.

**Where you will work**
-----------------------

As our new Marketing Manager Energy you will join the Marketing & Communications team within Industry & Buildings. Our team supports the Industry, Buildings, Data Centres and Energy markets. We work closely with technical experts and commercial colleagues. We work in a hybrid model, primarily from our offices in Amsterdam, Utrecht, Delft and Amersfoort, as well as from home.

Your focus is Energy, one of Haskoning’s nine Global Leading Markets. These are markets where we have a strong global position and aim to grow further. Within Energy, we support project developers, investors, governments and grid operators with their energy projects, from strategy and feasibility through to design and delivery. Our work covers areas including wind and solar energy, energy storage, hydrogen and energy infrastructure.

You report to the Director Marketing & Communications for Industry & Buildings. You provide direction on marketing activities, without line management responsibility.

**What you bring**
------------------

You are an experienced B2B marketer who understands how marketing supports long sales cycles and complex decision-making. You understand our clients’ challenges and translate them into relevant value propositions and a focused market approach. Ideally, you have a background in the energy sector. You are a confident adviser to senior leaders and bring together colleagues with different expertise and priorities. You take ownership of strategy, implementation and results.

You also bring:

* A degree in marketing, communications, business administration or a related field.
* Substantial relevant B2B marketing experience, typically seven years or more, including experience developing and implementing marketing strategies in an international organisation.
* Proven experience translating client and market research into positioning, value propositions and campaigns.
* Experience working closely with commercial teams and technical experts, using CRM and commercial data to agree priorities and improve your marketing approach.
* Experience managing budgets and building business cases for marketing investments.
* A strong interest in AI and an active approach to keeping up with developments. You know how to apply AI effectively in your work. Haskoning is investing significantly in AI, and you actively contribute to its adoption within our team.

**What you can expect from us**
-------------------------------

At Haskoning, we believe that the well-being of our employees is essential to our shared success. That’s why we offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support both your professional development and personal well-being.

Apply today and help us transform innovative ideas into sustainable solutions for tomorrow.

job.title: Strategic Enterprise Sales Manager Europe (English) @ 4PS (Ede, GE, NL)

job.description:
At **ABB**, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

**This position reports to:**

Resource Manager, NewGen

\_\_

Every great transformation starts with a clear plan and someone who can bring people together around it. As our **NewGen Project Manager**, you will be that person. You will shape how our projects are planned, delivered and adopted. You will turn ambitious ideas into measurable business outcomes, working with colleagues across functions and business areas at ABB.

**Key responsibilities:**
-------------------------

You will start by setting the direction. You will define a planning strategy that covers all the activities needed to manage the project well. You will choose the delivery approach that fits best, whether that is waterfall, agile or a hybrid. You will align with stakeholders on the scope and build a schedule that reflects it.

Next, you will define the budget, resources, timelines and work allocation together with your stakeholders. You will plan, coordinate and deliver your projects within the agreed time, scope, cost and quality. Along the way, you will prioritize tasks, keep project plans and charters up to date, and keep everyone informed of progress.

You will create the key project documents with your stakeholders. These include scope, acceptance criteria, financials, schedules and risk plans. You will guide the work through its phases and stage-gates, so resources are used efficiently and each milestone is met. You will make sure every activity follows company, program and IS procedures, as well as quality and safety standards.

Risk management will be part of your daily routine. You will identify, mitigate and monitor risks, issues and decisions, and you will spot opportunities and act on them. You will draw on your experience to anticipate contingencies and choose the best way forward. You will track progress, costs and resources, and address variances early.

You will also be the trusted contact and escalation point for your stakeholders. You will manage expectations, build strong relationships and keep projects aligned as strategies evolve. You will prepare and drive project and budget approvals, and you will define the governance structures and committees that support them. You will report on performance against plans and business outcomes, and you will keep a steady focus on realizing business value through delivery and implementation.

When a project closes, you will make sure the handover is smooth and capture lessons learned, so the next project benefits from them. Throughout, you will follow sound methodology, ABB directives and program management standards.

**What you bring:**
-------------------

To be successful in this role, you bring more than 12 years of project management experience, ideally in transformation or change programs. You are comfortable working in cross-functional environments with many stakeholders, and you know how to keep everyone moving in the same direction.

You have a proven track record of aligning projects with program objectives and delivering measurable business outcomes. Your strengths include project planning and execution, and managing resources and budgets. You are also experienced in managing risks, issues and dependencies, and you communicate clearly with stakeholders and governance forums.

You are a natural collaborator. You build alignment across multiple projects and teams, and you help business areas adopt change.

You also hold a recognized certification. This could be PRINCE2 Practitioner, PMP, an Agile/Scrum certification (such as CSM or SAFe), or ABB Program PM Certified under the IS Function Standard for IS Project Manager Certification.

**Why ABB**
-----------

At ABB, you will work in a global, collaborative environment with room to grow and learn. We welcome people from all backgrounds, perspectives and experiences. If you meet most of these criteria but not every one, we still encourage you to apply. We would like to hear your story.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit **https://www.abb.com** to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.
